name: Planning Commission Notice of Adjourned Regular Meeting of 4/22/25
agenda_text:
Steve Fowler,
  CITY OF EL MONTE  Director
  COMMUNITY AND ECONOMIC
  DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT

  CITY OF EL MONTE
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  NOTICE OF ADJOURNED
  REGULAR PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
  PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE SECTIONS
  54955 AND 54955.1
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the City of El Monte Planning
Commission has adjourned its Regular Planning Commission
Meeting of Tuesday, April 22, 2025, at 7:00 p.m. to an Adjourned
Regular Planning Commission meeting on Tuesday, May 13,
2025, at 7:00 p.m. to take place at the El Monte City Council
Chambers, 11333 Valley Boulevard, El Monte, CA 91731.
All public hearings that may have been noticed for the Regular
Planning Commission Meeting of Tuesday, April 22, 2025, are
also continued to the Adjourned Regular Meeting of Tuesday,
May 13, 2025, per Government Code Section 54955.1.

POSTED AT 5:00 P.M. on April 22, 2025 by SANDRA ELIAS,
PLANNING COMMISSION SECRETARY.

  11333 VALLEY BOULEVARD, EL MONTE, CALIFORNIA 91731-3293
  WEBSITE: www.elmonteca.gov
